d: Raghuraman faces challenges when he finds out that his daughter Abhi has fallen in love with Joginder Singh, a person from the Sikh community.
A police sub-inspector investigates the sudden disappearance of his beloved wife. When he finds out what happened to her, he sets out to exact revenge against the culprit.
The eldest lady of the family runs the house with utmost strictness. Things take a turn when her daughter-in-law's younger sister pays a visit and tries to change the rules of the house.
Azhagappan gets an opportunity to visit heaven and hell. When he notices that several atrocities are being committed in hell, he decides to tamper with the laws of life and death.
A man of virtues cannot stand the corruption and decides to raise his voice. However, things go haywire when he comes across his lookalike.
Kothai comes to India from France to trace his familial roots. Having learnt about his father's bitter past, he decides to reunite his entire family.
A comprehensive compilation of popular songs composed by renowned artists and musicians is played to entertain the listeners.
Devi, a young woman, is forced to marry Anand and have his child. However, she is unaware of his intentions and soon learns the truth.
The host sheds an extensive light on the personal and professional lives of some of the most renowned and talented actors of India.
Varadhan Annadurai, a newly appointed police officer, takes up an unsolved murder case of a couple, who were killed during their honeymoon.
